summary: Eleven criminal case numbers were opened at the Fairbanks courthouse on Oct. 28 in which the court names no defendant, recording each only as “Grand Jury.” The court file behind an Oct. 26 Fairbanks harassment and trespass arrest was filled in during the afternoon and charges Scott Glen Dayton with two Class B misdemeanors. Troopers say an inmate assault at the Fairbanks Correctional Center on Oct. 27 has been referred to prosecutors, and a new Fairbanks assault charge was filed by summons against Kenneth Tyrell White over an Oct. 21 incident. Earlier in the day troopers reported a domestic assault arrest at North Pole, a suspended-license arrest, a marijuana summons and a hit-and-run at a Geist Road gas station, and are searching for Sterling DeWilde, 45, of Fairbanks. A fourth Fairbanks case number can no longer be looked up in the state's public case database. The court's weekly report for Oct. 21 to 27 counts 48 new criminal cases at Fairbanks, one at Nenana, one at Delta Junction and none at Healy; those are the report's own counts for its own window and do not include the twelve cases opened on Oct. 28.

entries.title: Eleven Fairbanks criminal case numbers opened with no defendant named
body: Eleven criminal case numbers were opened at the Fairbanks courthouse on Oct. 28 in which the court records the defendant only as “Grand Jury.” Each carries a single count recorded as a charging document pending or not filed, with no degree of offense, and none has a hearing set.
No person is named on any of the eleven and no charge, place or time is recorded on them. Cases 4FA-26-02180CR through 4FA-26-02190CR.

entries.title: Assault charge: Kenneth Tyrell White
body: Kenneth Tyrell White is charged with assault in the fourth degree — recklessly causing injury to another person — a Class A misdemeanor. The charge is dated Oct. 21 at Fairbanks.
The case was opened at the Fairbanks courthouse on Oct. 28 on a charging document from Fairbanks Police, and a summons was issued the same day. He was not arrested.
Case 4FA-26-02191CR. No hearing is set.

entries.title: Assault report at the Fairbanks jail referred for charges: Sharai Guzman
body: Troopers say the Fairbanks Correctional Center reported an inmate assault on Oct. 27 at about 9 p.m., and that their investigation found Sharai Guzman committed assault in the fourth degree — recklessly causing injury to another person — not involving domestic violence.

Troopers say charges were forwarded to the District Attorney's Office for review. No arrest was reported and no charge has been filed in court; no 2026 case appears under that name in the state's case database.
Alaska State Troopers case AK26106628.

entries.title: Harassment and trespass charges: Scott Glen Dayton
body: Scott Glen Dayton, 29, is charged with criminal trespass in the second degree — entering or remaining on premises unlawfully — and harassment in the second degree — conduct likely to provoke a violent response. Both are Class B misdemeanors.
Fairbanks Police record the arrest at the 1300 block of South University Avenue on Oct. 26 at 11:12 p.m. Police case 26003289.
Case 4FA-26-02173CR; the complaint was filed Oct. 28 and he was released on standard conditions. Arraignment Nov. 3.

entries.title: DV criminal mischief charge: Dalton Curtis Wayne Benefield
body: Dalton Curtis Wayne Benefield is charged with criminal mischief in the fourth degree — damaging property worth $250 to $749 — a Class A misdemeanor recorded as domestic violence.

Troopers say they responded to a domestic disturbance at a home on Homer Drive in North Pole and found extensive damage to the residence. Troopers arrested him on a third-degree count, for damage over $750; the charge filed in court is the lower fourth-degree count.
Case 4FA-26-02178CR; arraigned Oct. 28, pre-trial conference Dec. 24, trial week Jan. 4, 2027.

entries.title: DV assault charges: Maia Mae Hannum
body: Maia Mae Hannum is charged with assault in the fourth degree — recklessly causing injury to another person — and two counts of assault when a child is present. All three are Class A misdemeanors recorded as domestic violence.
The charges are dated Oct. 28 at North Pole. Case 4FA-26-02179CR; arraigned Oct. 28, pre-trial conference Dec. 24, trial week Jan. 4, 2027.

entries.title: Domestic assault arrest in North Pole
body: Troopers say they responded to a domestic disturbance at a North Pole home at about 6 a.m. on Oct. 28 and arrested a woman on an assault charge committed in the presence of two children. The release does not name her.
Alaska State Troopers case AK26106667.

entries.title: Theft charge: Samuel Martese-Tutton Harris
body: Samuel Martese-Tutton Harris is charged with theft in the third degree — taking property worth less than $250, with prior theft convictions — a Class A misdemeanor. The charge is dated Oct. 27 at North Pole.
Case 4FA-26-02177CR; arraignment Nov. 3.

entries.title: Missing person: Sterling DeWilde
body: Sterling DeWilde, 45, of Fairbanks was reported missing to Fairbanks police on Oct. 24 and was last heard from on Sept. 11, troopers say. A search is under way in the Fairbanks and Huslia areas.
Anyone with information is asked to call Fairbanks police at 907-450-6500, case 26-3257.

entries.title: Suspended-license arrest: James Carpentino
body: James Carpentino, 48, of North Pole, was arrested on a charge of driving while his license was canceled, suspended or revoked — driving while a license suspension for a criminal offense is in force — recorded by troopers as a Class A misdemeanor.

Troopers say they stopped him for a moving violation on Oct. 27 at about 5:09 p.m., that the investigation showed his license was actively suspended for a criminal offense, and that he had a prior conviction for the same offense within the last 10 years. He was taken to the Fairbanks Correctional Center.
Alaska State Troopers case AK26106550. Court case 4FA-26-02176CR was opened Oct. 28; no charging document has been filed. Arraignment Nov. 3.

entries.title: Marijuana summons: Jeremyah Murphy
body: Jeremyah Murphy, 18, was issued a summons on a charge of misconduct involving a controlled substance in the sixth degree — possessing a small amount of marijuana in breach of the state's limits — and released at the scene.

Troopers say they stopped the vehicle on Geist Road at about 8:05 p.m. on Oct. 27 because it had no illuminated rear license plate, that they detected the odor of marijuana, and that Murphy voluntarily provided several dispensary containers, one of which held a partly smoked blunt.
Alaska State Troopers case AK26106606. No charge class is recorded and no court case has been filed.

entries.title: Hit-and-run at a Fairbanks gas station
body: Troopers are investigating a hit-and-run collision at the Circle K at Geist Road and Fairbanks Street on Oct. 27 at about 3:30 p.m. No one has been arrested or charged.

Troopers say witnesses reported a white Toyota Tacoma backing into a parked vehicle and leaving without providing information to the owner, and that surveillance footage from the business matched the witness account.
Alaska State Troopers case AK26106583. Troopers ask anyone with information to call the Fairbanks post at 907-451-5100.

entries.title: DV assault charge: Nicolette Nicolai
body: Nicolette Nicolai is charged with assault in the fourth degree — recklessly causing injury to another person — a Class A misdemeanor recorded as domestic violence. The charge is dated Oct. 19 at Fairbanks.
The case was filed Oct. 21 and the court issued a warrant on Oct. 22 with bail of $250 cash performance, with the defendant not to be released until the court approves conditions.
Case 4FA-26-02132CR. No hearing is set.

entries.title: DUI charge: Anthony Morandi Sosa
body: Anthony Morandi Sosa is charged with driving under the influence — operating a vehicle while impaired by alcohol or drugs — a Class A misdemeanor. The charge is dated Oct. 24 at North Pole and the court record lists a breath reading of .163.
The case was filed at the Fairbanks courthouse on Oct. 24 and he was released on Oct. 26 on standard conditions.
Case 4FA-26-02151CR; arraignment Oct. 30.

entries.title: Four Fairbanks case numbers cannot be looked up online
body: Four criminal case numbers at the Fairbanks courthouse cannot be found in the state's public case database.

Case 4FA-26-02127CR, listed in the court system's weekly charges report as filed on Oct. 21 against Annette Keogh with no charging document filed, returns no records on a search by case number. Cases 4FA-26-02165CR and 4FA-26-02171CR, reported earlier this week, still return no records; both closed on Oct. 26 and both are printed again in the latest report.

A fourth, 4FA-26-02174CR against William Howard Frasure, could still be retrieved on the morning of Oct. 28 and could not that afternoon. It was recorded as filed and closed on Oct. 27 with no charging document filed. Case numbers either side of it can still be retrieved.
